dockerStartCmd:
set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x /usr/sbin/sshd ]; then apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-server; fi; command -v rsync >/dev/null || (apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends rsync); key=${RUNPOD_PUBLIC_KEY:-${SSH_PUBLIC_KEY:-${PUBLIC_KEY:-}}}; test -n "$key"; mkdir -p /run/sshd /root/.ssh; chmod 700 /root/.ssh; printf '%s
' "$key" > /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; ssh-keygen -A; /usr/sbin/sshd; sleep infinity
